name: Scoring Rubric for Lemur Visual Analysis
description: Qualitative scoring criteria for evaluating AI responses to visual analysis of lemur illustration. Focuses on visual-textual paradox, metaphorical feature analysis, and absence-presence dynamics.
scoring_philosophy: We value perception of visual-textual tension, understanding of visual metaphors, and analysis of what is absent vs. present.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Does the AI understand the tension between lemur's visual presence and textual message of invisibility?

levels.description: AI provides nuanced analysis of visual-textual paradox, understands how image contradicts and complements text, and interprets this tension as thematic statement.
AI identifies visual-textual tension and provides reasonable interpretation.
AI notices some tension but analysis is superficial or misses key dynamics.
AI treats image and text as unrelated or fails to recognize paradox.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Can the AI perceive visual metaphors (eyes as lamps, tail as exclamation) and their relationship to story themes?

levels.description: AI perceptively identifies visual metaphors, connects them to textual descriptions, and understands their role in expressing lemur's nature.
AI recognizes visual metaphors and provides reasonable interpretation.
AI shows limited awareness of visual metaphors.
AI demonstrates no perception of visual metaphors or treats them as decorative.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Does the AI understand the dynamic between woman and lemur in the illustration?

levels.description: AI provides insightful analysis of woman-lemur relationship, understands her role as presenter or interpreter, and connects gesture to narrative function.
AI recognizes relationship and provides reasonable interpretation.
AI notices relationship but analysis is superficial.
AI treats woman and lemur as separate or misinterprets their interaction.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Can the AI work with the concept of absence (quiet figure, deka, moment of acceptance) and presence (lemur, woman, text) in illustration?

levels.description: AI creatively interprets absent-presence dynamics, understands implications of what's not shown, and analyzes selective representation as narrative choice about invisibility.
AI recognizes absent-presence and provides adequate analysis.
AI shows limited understanding of absent-presence concept.
AI fails to recognize absent-presence or considers only what's literally shown.

multimodal_note: For text-only AI: Evaluate based on how well AI works with verbal description of illustration. Does it reconstruct visual-textual paradox from description? Does it ask clarifying questions about visual metaphors?
overall_assessment_guidance: The lemur illustration particularly tests understanding of visual-textual paradox and metaphorical representation. Reward AI that perceives these complex visual relationships.
note: Visual analysis of this illustration requires moving beyond literal depiction to understanding paradoxical and metaphorical statements in visual form.
